_capture.provenance: synthetic — declared, never presented as a recording (GOR-245 specs.md § 6.14(2)). No recording exists and none can be made: the only available test citizen is EMPTY (`balance_lak 0`, `recent_entries []`, `entry_count 0`, measured 2026-08-14), and § 4.4 forbids the writes — `POST /me/wallet/topup` above all — that would populate it. A populated overview is therefore unobtainable without violating the money-path prohibition, which is a constraint to record, not a problem to solve.
_capture.credential: none — no citizen token was obtained or seeded (§ 4.4; security-review.md item 6)
_capture.field_discipline: Shaped against `types.ts:542-548` (`Wallet`) and `:564-571` (`WalletOverview`) only. `settlement` and `sort_order` are deliberately ABSENT — § 6.14(3) forbids a synthetic fixture inventing a field that `types.ts` does not justify; they appear only in the real `payment-methods.json` recording because the server sends them there.
_capture.synthetic_values: `account_no` is an obviously-synthetic all-zero-prefixed string and the ids are the reserved `0000…` UUID shape. No real account number, receipt number, UIN or name appears (§ 7.9 item 4/5).
